name: Cursor 3
summary: Cursor 3 should get a cautious T1 public-surface pass focused on visible claims, access friction, pricing clarity, and proof depth.

claims.claim: Homepage loads without login and value proposition is visible
claims.evidence: "Built to make you extraordinarily productive, Cursor is the best way to code with AI."

claims.claim: Primary agent capability is stated in concrete, testable terms
claims.evidence: "Agents use their own computers to build, test, and demo features end to end for you to review."

claims.claim: Pricing or free/trial path is publicly discoverable
claims.evidence: Hobby Free Includes: ✓ No credit card required ✓ Limited Agent requests ✓ Limited Tab completions

claims.claim: Core workflow can be inspected from public docs, demo, templates, or repository
claims.evidence: Cursor is an AI editor and coding agent. Use it to understand your codebase, plan and build features, fix bugs, review changes, and work with the tools you already use.

claims.claim: Trust, privacy, or data-handling claims are findable from public navigation
claims.evidence: "Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Data Use, Security"

claims.claim: Competitor/differentiation claim is specific enough to verify
Public surface exposes at least one realistic scenario for the review engine
claims.evidence: Agents use their own computers to build, test, and demo features end to end for you to review.
